channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Holy Mackinaw: The Best Calls Of Joe Bowen’s Maple Leafs Broadcasting Career
item.description: Joe Bowen has been the voice of the Toronto Maple Leafs for 44 years, delivering passion and demonstrating his love for his job in every call. The all-time great commentator will retire at the end of the season, and today we look back at some of his most iconic calls.

item.title: Four NHL Players Who Made Strong First Impressions With Their New Team
item.description: Most NHL players acquired at this season's trade deadline have played their first game with their new team. But which NHLers made their mark right out of the gate with their new teams?

item.title: It's Official: The Buffalo Sabres Are For Real This Season
item.description: Yes, Virginia, the Buffalo Sabres are for real. What they accomplished Sunday against the Tampa Bay Lightning in one of the wildest games of the season shows they can do damage in the playoffs.

item.title: Nobody's Punchline Anymore — How A Joke In 'Heated Rivalry' May Have Inspired The Sabres' Turnaround
item.description: Since Dec. 11, the Sabres have gone an NHL-best 26-5-2. On Sunday, they beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 8-7 in a fight-filled game that catapulted Buffalo into top spot in the Atlantic Division.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Auston Matthews' Future Raises Questions, Plus Canadiens Buzz
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs' disappointing season has raised concerns over Auston Matthews' future with the club. Meanwhile, Montreal Canadiens GM Kent Hughes said his club attempted to make a major move at the trade deadline.

item.title: NHL Nugget: Brent Burns, The League's Oldest Active Skater, Turns 41
item.description: Brent Burns, the NHL's oldest active skater this season, turns 41 on March 9. One of the NHL's fan favorites has been a defenseman for most of his career, but not all of it.

item.title: Who's Hot And Cold In The NHL: Will Mark Scheifele's Strong Play Fuel A Miracle Jets Comeback?
item.description: First-liners on the Jets and Avalanche were red-hot this past week, while a Senators veteran and Golden Knights netminder got called out for not meeting expectations.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: Dubnyk Discusses The Leafs, Sabres, Avalanche, Bobrovsky And More
item.description: Former NHL goalie Devan Dubnyk, Ryan Kennedy and Andrew McInnis discuss the Sabres' hot streak, the Avalanche's outlook, why it's tough to predict the Maple Leafs' plan, and much more.

item.title: Three NHL Trade Deadline Sellers That Should Bounce Back Next Season
item.description: Who would have predicted before the season that the Florida Panthers, Winnipeg Jets and Toronto Maple Leafs would be sellers at the NHL trade deadline? There are signs that each of them will bounce back.

item.title: The Maple Leafs Need To Follow The Bruins' Prints And Keep Losing
item.description: The Boston Bruins fell to fifth-last season, and look where they are now. The Toronto Maple Leafs should try to do the same so they not only help themselves but also prevent helping the Bruins.
